household_message.text: Car full for my trip, leaving early tomorrow.

message_to_household: I can set the car to full, but I need a specific ready-by time to plan the charge. What time tomorrow should it be ready?

questions.text: When does the car need to be ready? “Early tomorrow” is too vague to schedule—please give a clock time.

problems: the household gave no clear time for the car; ask when it must be ready
